tasks.label: 1. Backend (8001) + Ngrok
tasks.command: Start-Job -ScriptBlock { Start-Sleep -Seconds 3; try { $t = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:8001/api/v1/tunnel/start' -Method Post -ContentType 'application/json' -Body '{}' -TimeoutSec 15; Write-Host "[+] Ngrok: $($t.public_url)" -ForegroundColor Green } catch { Write-Host "[!] Ngrok warning: $($_.Exception.Message)" -ForegroundColor Yellow } } | Out-Null; python -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8001

tasks.label: 3. Kali SSH Tunnel (lucy)
tasks.command: ssh -tt -o BatchMode=yes -o ServerAliveInterval=30 -o ServerAliveCountMax=3 -L 5001:127.0.0.1:5000 lucy@192.168.253.133 'ss -tln | grep -q ":5000 " || (nohup /usr/bin/kali-server-mcp --ip 127.0.0.1 --port 5000 >/tmp/kali-server-mcp.log 2>&1 </dev/null &); sleep 1; touch /tmp/kali-server-mcp.log; echo "[+] Kali SSH Tunnel active (127.0.0.1:5001 -> Kali:5000) - Streaming MCP logs:"; tail -n 30 -F /tmp/kali-server-mcp.log'

inputs.description: Authorized target URL to assess with XSSSpect
